archetypes.name: stale-reader-sweep
archetypes.rationale: The plan relocates three Codex output files but names only four update targets; other scripts, CI pipelines, or step scripts may read those paths from the old IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR root and are not in the update list.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan moves manifest.json, qa-pending.json, and the codex impl transcript from $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR root to $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/codex-step2-out/ and names exactly four targets to update: launch-codex-implement.sh, step-7a.sh, test-codex-implementer.sh, and test-step2-dispatch.sh. Search the entire repo for any other script, CI workflow, skill file, or helper that references codex-impl-transcript, $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/manifest.json, or $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/qa-pending.json at the root level. For each reference found outside the plan's update list, determine whether it is a reader of a Codex-written output (stale after the move) or an orchestrator-owned file that intentionally stays at the root. Flag any unplanned reader as a plan gap. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-table-exhaustiveness
archetypes.rationale: The plan gives a precise 16-row table of codex-path tests requiring STEP2_MANIFEST_PATH retargeting; verifying that no codex-path stub is missing from the table and no cursor-only test is misclassified requires reading the actual harness files against the table.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan lists exactly 16 codex-path test IDs in test-step2-dispatch.sh that must retarget STEP2_MANIFEST_PATH to codex-step2-out/, and declares cursor-only tests 3e, M1b, and 23 unchanged. Read skills/implement/scripts/test-step2-dispatch.sh and skills/implement/scripts/test-codex-implementer.sh to verify: every test that sets STEP2_MANIFEST_PATH on a codex path is in the plan's table; no cursor-only test is in the table; META path references for 17a/17b/17c and the test-16 qa-pending stub are the only special-case overrides needed beyond the manifest-path rows. Flag any codex-path stub that writes to the old IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR root that the plan's table omits, and flag any table entry that does not correspond to a real test ID in the harness file. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
